frontend/src/api/contracts/peaksSidecar..purpose: Contract type + validator for the server-computed peaks sidecar JSON served at GET .../assets/peaks (app/engines/audio_ops.py#compute_peaks_sidecar's schema).

exports.name: PeaksSidecar
exports.contract: {version: typeof CURRENT_SIDECAR_VERSION (=2), peaks:number[], duration_sec, sample_rate, channels, peaks_per_sec, source:{filename,size_bytes,mtime_ns}}

exports.name: parsePeaksSidecar
exports.contract: (json: unknown) -> number[]|null; validates version===CURRENT_SIDECAR_VERSION and every peak in [0,1] -- returns null (never throws) on any shape/version/range mismatch.

exports.name: CURRENT_SIDECAR_VERSION
exports.contract: =2. Must be bumped in lockstep with SIDECAR_VERSION in app/engines/audio_ops.py.

notes: 2026-07-12 BUG FOUND+FIXED: this file hardcoded version:1 from when it was written, but the backend bumped SIDECAR_VERSION to 2 on 2026-07-10 (density increase) -- silently rejected every real sidecar payload for 2+ days, the actual root cause of long chapters never showing waveform tape detail (confirmed via live network capture of a real version:2 200 OK being discarded client-side). Now validates against the exported CURRENT_SIDECAR_VERSION constant instead of a hardcoded literal.

frontend/src/api/fetchPeaksSidecar.ts.purpose: Fetches and validates the server-computed peaks sidecar for a chapter audio URL, for PlayerBar's over-duration-cap tape rendering.

exports.name: derivePeaksUrl
exports.contract: (audioUrl) -> string|null; string-replaces /assets/audio -> /assets/peaks (same filename query param); null for non-chapter-asset-shaped URLs (segment/preview/sample) so callers never fire a request for them.

exports.name: fetchPeaksSidecar
exports.contract: (audioUrl) -> Promise<number[]|null>; fetch + parsePeaksSidecar; null (never throws) on any non-matching URL, non-2xx response, or malformed payload.
